description: Derived from AGSC-08-01: every item MUST carry `prov{origin, operator}`, and a missing `operator` is AGSC-E503, an error; a missing `prov` would be AGSC-E501 instead (`fm-0004`). One concept is added to the minimal fixture whose `prov` names its origin and no operator; every other key conforms and it is a member of the fixture's cluster. The whole list `lint` reports is one AGSC-E503 error naming that file and item, and lint exits 1.
